rows: Ek badi cheez / Bada ajr (dono par Tanween)
Bada Arsh / Seedha raasta (dono par الْـ)
Khuli nishani / Paakiza kalimah (dono ke aakhir mein ة)

data.text: **Qaa'ida (Pages 77–79):** Arbi mein jab kisi ism (Mawsoof) ki achhai, burai ya haalat (Sifat) bayan ki jati hai toh **Mawsoof pehle** aur **Sifat baad mein** aati hai (`شَيْءٌ عَظِيمٌ` badi cheez). Dono ki aakhri harkat (`ـٌ / ـً / ـٍ`), `الْـ` ka hona ya na hona, aur muzakkar/mu'annas hona bilkul yaksaan hota hai.

data.text: Stage 3 mein hum Murakkab-e-Tawseefi seekhenge — yani Noun aur Adjective ka Qurani murakkab. Sifat hamesha Mausoof ke baad aati hai aur dono ka irab aur jins milta hai. Neeche di gayi Qurani ibaarat mein adjective laal rang mein hai.
